data.narrative:
Glyphic Biotechnologies is a Series A biotech company founded by Joshua Yang and Daniel Estandian that has raised $44M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 3 public-market peers in Biotech & Health (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private-sector comparables including Colossal Biosciences, Abridge, and Recursion Pharmaceuticals.

Only one valuation method proved applicable given available data. Stage-Progression analysis, which uses the $44M total raised as a proxy for current value and applies a 2.0x multiplier typical of Series A-to-next-stage advancement, yields an implied valuation of $88M. Public-Comp Anchoring could not be applied because the target's revenue is not on file, a common constraint for private biotech; the public median P/S of 5.5x across three tickers cannot be deployed without this input. Peer-Median triangulation was similarly unavailable due to insufficient narrow-set matches—while 8 same-sector peers exist, none satisfied the filters for stage, adjacency, or valuation tier required for robust median calculation.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $75M (low) to $101M (high), centered on $88M. This range reflects the single applicable method and carries material uncertainty around revenue trajectory and clinical-stage risk factors that comparable companies' public multiples would normally help calibrate. Additional disclosure of revenue or alternative metrics would substantially improve precision.
